visual.detailed_description: A white-background diagram with bold row headings, blue arrow axes, dated nodes and short event labels, with some words in red.

panels.general_description: Two stacked horizontal clinical timelines labeled CASE1 and CASE2 with dated nodes, event labels above and treatment labels below.
panels.detailed_description: White background. Each timeline has a vertical blue line at the left, a horizontal blue arrow axis with dated nodes, bold row headings 'diagnosis and progression' above the axis and 'treatment' below it, and the case label (CASE1 above, CASE2 below) at the far left. CASE1 nodes read 2021 local hospital, 2022.9 our hospital, 2023.1, 2023.2, 2023.5, 2023.6, 2024.1 and an arrow to ongoing follow -up.
